mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: Rising residential sales (RSAFS) above 360,000 million dollars signals strengthening consumer confidence and housing market activity, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 360,000 million dollars.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 112.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 112.0.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1800.0 thousand units signals weakening residential demand, reducing consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 1800.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in nonfarm payrolls indicate labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5% and UNRATE declines while PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increases in CPI inflation above 2.5% signal accommodative policy amid rising prices, delaying rate hikes and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises above 2.5%.
